sentence: This project builds a mindfulness-based intervention to reduce alcohol misuse and tobacco use among college students who experienced sexual violence.
This project studies how tyrosine phosphorylation of a proline metabolism enzyme changes its activity and drives resistance to chemoimmunotherapy in lung cancer.
This project studies how social interaction protects against heroin craving in rats by looking at the genomic network involved.
This project studies how brain circuits change behavior when a reward is unexpectedly omitted, using neuronal recordings and circuit activity manipulations.
This project builds animal models of cancer and uses imaging in those models.
This project studies how telomere shortening changes the absorptive cells of the intestine and how those changes lead to intestinal inflammation.
This project designs and tests drugs that target an essential enzyme Cryptococcus needs to survive, aiming to treat fungal infections.
This project builds a surgical robot and a low-field MRI scanner that work together to remove prostate cancer tissue without incisions.
This project tests whether a vaccine carrying parts of two respiratory viruses can protect against both viruses.
This project studies how transporter proteins help tsetse flies, their bacterial partner and trypanosomes exchange amino acids.
This project develops methods to capture the proteins made in neurons whose activity matters for a particular brain disease model.
This project uses mouse genetic models to study how several genetic variants control how cataracts progress and how severe they become.
This project studies how an enzyme that modifies tRNA affects acute myeloid leukemia and tests a small molecule inhibitor of that enzyme.
This project tests whether long-term alcohol exposure changes a thalamostriatal circuit that holds back alcohol seeking, leading to excessive alcohol use.
This project tests a behavioral intervention in a randomized trial for adults with advanced cancer who fear cancer progression.
This project looks for molecular markers of protection and disease in mice with Chlamydia trachomatis infections to support vaccine development.
This project uses high-speed atomic force microscopy to watch how spike proteins of the virus that causes COVID-19 change and interact with host cells.
This project develops imaging methods to understand cancer and the tumor microenvironment and to find biomarkers for early detection of cancer.
This project studies how a rare genetic variant helps protect the blood-brain barrier and guards against Alzheimer's disease, using zebrafish models.
